newMechanic.name: Ad-free Sprint
newMechanic.description: A global status that suppresses native Taboola units (e42, e47, e41, e37) and article banners (e15, e17, e22) by setting container height to zero while active.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: The app has high ad density without an earnable path to a clean reading experience.

parsed.trigger: A promotional card appears after the user scrolls past the top stories on the Home News Feed.
parsed.eligibility: Non-signed-in users currently viewing high-density native and banner advertisements.

offer.title: 15 Minutes of Ad-Free News
offer.body: Play a 15-second game with our News Anchor to remove all feed and article advertisements.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The 15-minute window is strictly time-boxed to provide a sampling effect of a premium experience without replacing long-term ad-free subscriptions.
risks: Users may wait for sprint availability rather than browsing during standard ad density.
Potential for minor disruption when ads return at the end of the sprint period.

newElements.change: An inline feed card titled 'Ad-Free Sprint' with a 'Play to Clear Ads' button.
A countdown timer badge next to the 'Home' title showing remaining ad-free time.
A sidebar menu item 'Ad-Free Sprint' to provide a secondary hub entry point.
A subtle notification toast appearing 60 seconds before sprint expiry to prevent jarring transitions.
